In this role, you will work alongside team members to identify areas for improvement, support idea submission, and help coordinate projects while keeping processes well documented for future reference. The focus of the role is on improving safety, quality, productivity, and profitability across the organization.
You will also work with colleagues across departments to develop, evaluate, and improve process flow and work methods. Together with cross-functional teams, you will help advance Lean manufacturing principles and continuous improvement initiatives to streamline production, increase efficiency, and improve effectiveness.
cond_0387.responsibilities:
Work with production teams to find and implement strategies that reduce waste, helping make operations leaner and more efficient.
Coordinate with teams across departments to explore cost-saving opportunities and support ongoing improvement efforts.
Participate in CI boards, where improvement ideas are gathered collaboratively and brought to life.
Help evaluate processes, share best practices, and support smooth day-to-day operations.
Create clear, accessible documentation so that procedures are easy to understand and follow across the organization.
Share knowledge of lean principles and help others across the organization apply them in their work.
cond_0387.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Professional work experience in a manufacturing environment
Strong computer skills, especially in MS Office, for data analysis and documentation
Ability to interpret prints for understanding and optimizing production processes
Demonstrated ability to use structured problem-solving techniques
Bachelor's degree in Engineering
Preferred Requirements
Industrial Engineering degree
Knowledge of Lean and/or Six Sigma
